body:
## Summary

Passport numbers are only detected when they follow an explicit label such as `паспорт:`. Formats commonly found in logs and AI sessions without such a label are missed. This contributed to a real leak of passport data.

## Reproduction (synthetic data)

```js
const s = createSanitizer();
for (const t of [
  'series and number: 45 17 839204',          // RU domestic passport
  '4517 839204',                              // RU domestic, compact
  'загран 75 4930281',                        // RU international passport
]) console.log((await s.sanitize(t)).text);
// None are redacted. (By contrast, 'UK passport 123456789' and 'pasaporte AB1234567' are detected.)
```

## Expected

- Russian domestic passport `dd dd dddddd` / `dddd dddddd` and international `dd ddddddd` as format rules, with higher confidence when Russian/English passport vocabulary appears within a window (not only as a `key: value` label).
- Country formats with validation where public algorithms exist (ICAO 9-character document numbers with check digit, US 9 digits, UK 9 digits, DE `[CFGHJK][0-9CFGHJKLMNPRTVWXYZ]{8}`, IN `[A-Z][0-9]{7}`, KR `M[0-9]{3}[A-Z][0-9]{4}`, IT `[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{7}`), using a Presidio-style confidence model: low score without context, high with context or checksum.
- Multilingual context vocabulary: passport, паспорт, загранпаспорт, серия, номер, pasaporte, Reisepass, passeport, passaporto, 护照, パスポート.

## Tests

Positive and negative fixtures per country, including numbers next to unrelated digits (timestamps, version numbers, phone numbers) to keep false positives measured.
title: Detect passport numbers without explicit labels (Russian domestic/international and country formats)
